dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Daddy doesn't have time to play, so I'll have to go hang out with the baby Saurians instead...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your dad's a busy man, then?

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Not at all! All he does is walk around our encampment with his chest puffed out.

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: And he always tells me not to make too much noise around the Saurians. Hmph! I bet he just wants me to stay at home and do homework all day, every day. That sure would be easier for him, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Hmph, well if he thinks I'll play ball with not playing ball, he's got another thing coming! I'm gonna go play hide-and-seek with the baby Saurians!

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: But it's so hard to beat Iktomisaurs at hide-and-seek... If only there were some Tepetlisaurs nearby instead.

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: She's a doctor, so she's super busy! She's often out working, and she even brings delicious food back home.

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: But whenever she's not out, she takes me to see Granny Itztli...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Mom always brings Granny Citlali cabbages, Grainfruit, and herbs. After that, she gets Granny to teach me some classes and leave me some homework...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Granny's homework is always so hard... Y'know what? Come to think of it, it's best that adults stay busy!

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Playing cards is a blast! Come on, let's play another round!

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Ugh... Playing cards is hard. It's even harder than hide-and-seek...
